SpecialistResult shape.question: Does SpecialistResult carry an explicit completion status?
SpecialistResult shape.answer: Required status field, no default, full enum: COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE_DUE_TO_BUDGET, REFUSED, STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_ERROR, BLOCKED. An empty findings list is never ambiguous and a constructor cannot omit it.

SpecialistResult shape.question: Does SpecialistResult carry per-query budget accounting?
SpecialistResult shape.answer: No - run-level BudgetConsumption on RunManifest is enough. SpecialistResult stays analysis output. Recorded tradeoff: INCOMPLETE_DUE_TO_BUDGET reaches a reviewer with no per-query account of what it spent.

SpecialistResult shape.question: What identifies the query on a SpecialistResult that produced zero findings?
SpecialistResult shape.answer: Criterion descriptor (decision_domain, policy_pack_id, policy_id, criterion_id - a new sibling type to FindingAuthority WITHOUT its >=1 policy-citation requirement, since a query does not cite) plus the existing GeneratedBy (node, model_alias, prompt_version). No tool-allowlist id, no evidence-considered list.

SpecialistResult shape.question: INTERRUPTED - not answered. A refusal produces no finding, so its blocking InformationGap has nothing to attach to. Where does it live?
